Step: 1405 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
240 days before 04-02-1405:  
Go back 4 months (approx 122 days) to 04-10-1404 (since 1404 is a leap year).  
Remaining days: 240 - 122 = 118 days earlier from 04-10-1404.  
118 days before 04-10-1404:  
March has 31 days → back to 03-10-1404 is 31 days earlier (118-31=87 left).  
February in leap year 1404 has 29 days → back to 02-10-1404 is 29 days earlier (87-29=58 left).  
January has 31 days → back to 01-10-1404 is 31 days earlier (58-31=27 left).  
27 days before 01-10-1404 = 1403-12-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1403-12-14
